name: Genie AI
tagline: Agentic legal AI that drafts, reviews, and negotiates contracts from your playbooks.
description: Genie AI is a legal AI platform for drafting, reviewing, editing, and negotiating business contracts. It can generate personalized, jurisdiction-aware agreements — up to 50+ pages — in minutes, flag risks in existing documents, and learn an organization's standards and playbooks to keep edits on-policy. London-based, it offers a free tier plus paid Pro, Business, and Enterprise plans for in-house legal teams and firms.
insight: Raised a $17.8M Series A in Oct 2024 led by Google Ventures, with Khosla Ventures — Genie's first institutional round.
edge: Goes beyond review-only legal AI: drafts full contracts from a prompt, not just redlines on documents you already have.
pros: Backed by Google Ventures and Khosla

references.title: Genie AI raises £13.3m Series A led by Google Ventures
